paragraphs: Bar Aviv and bar Kippuk (the Arukh’s reading: Kippoz). Their feet turned that day, so they did not deliver Rav Ashi’s funeral oration; Mo'ed Katan 25; see Yevamot 103. Another reading: bar Avin.
